g.title: A
g.text: production: YARP gateway + six services on Azure Container Apps · development and tests: single host
ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md · ADR 0002–0019 · status as of stage 3

g.title: users
g.text: Brand manager · Service engineer · Warehouse keeper

g.title: web
g.text: Blazor WebAssembly + MudBlazor, runs in the browser, prerendered by its host
sign-in page · menu by policy · typed HTTP clients with antiforgery
SmartSpare.ApiContracts DTOs only · no tokens in the browser

g.title: gw
g.text: external HTTPS ingress · hosts the WASM client · /bff sign-in
HttpOnly SameSite cookie + antiforgery · rate limit · /scalar + OpenAPI
swaps the cookie for a 2-min ES256 internal token (ADR 0016)
cookie scheme only · never routes /internal · scales to zero

g.title: t_aca
g.text: one image and one revision per app · every app scales to zero · warm-up before demos · ADR 0009, 0015

g.title: svcs
g.text: (service hosts: stage 4) — each: own image, own database login, JwtBearer only, scale to zero (woken by HTTP or its queues),
handler pipeline (ADR 0005), outbox / inbox (ADR 0003), DbContext + migrations. Module code is implemented; use cases come with the module's stage

g.title: kv
g.text: Azure Key Vault + Managed Identity per app (stage 4)
token signing key · CloudAMQP URL · Grafana Cloud token

g.title: mq
g.text: CloudAMQP — RabbitMQ, free Little Lemur plan (stage 4, ADR 0017)
topic exchange per publishing module · durable queue per consumer
one dead-letter queue per module · 1 connection per service · ≤ 100 queues

g.title: obs
g.text: dashboards and alert rules as code · 14-day retention

g.title: db
g.text: ref · util · audit (Platform) │ iam │ catalog · inventory · raw · staging │ fleet │ procurement │ forecast │ mart
no FKs, JOINs or transactions across modules · outbox / inbox and __ef_migrations_history per module
triggers · functions · views · materialised views · roles and grants (SQL parts in db/sql/<module>)
one login per service (smartspare_identity … smartspare_reporting), pool ≤ 4 each (B1ms: 35 connections), per-module roles in stage 10

g.title: mljob
g.text: reservation expiry · mart refresh · audit purge

g.title: t_db
g.text: PostgreSQL 17 — one database, schemas owned by modules (ADR 0011)
locally Aspire / docker compose, in CI Testcontainers · Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server (stage 4)

g.title: ci
g.text: SQL suite on the EF-built database

g.title: single
g.text: HTTP API + BFF: /bff sign-in, HttpOnly cookie, antiforgery, strict CSP
hosts the WASM client · all six modules in one process
in-process events and Contracts queries · used locally, in tests and CI

g.title: runner
g.text: bootstrap + EF migrations in ModuleCatalog order
check-model · used by Aspire and CI
